reference.observation: Snow-covered Iliamna image shows steep summit and unequal lower shoulders/divides; snow hides rock and exact vent. Not a template for an exact reconstruction. Consult-only pixels not copied into QA package.

concept.observation: Stratovolcano concept has substantial nested middle-scale flank articulation; treated as artistic guide, not factual source. Original decisions reject obligatory regular layers.

original_frames.observation: Mostly smooth cone with long shallow radial seams; branch hierarchy not readable.
Long radial panels and transverse facet rows dominate; no readable nested junctions.
Correct concave cone but largely uninterrupted flank surface.
Steep summit and wide skirt correct; main flank remains broad smooth panels.
Broad wedge faces and shallow radial ribbons, insufficient nested structure.
Radial convergence around a small vent; branch-to-trunk hierarchy not readable.
Smooth conical volume dominates without material variation; missing middle-scale relief confirmed.
Correct concave-cone category, but passing outline cannot substitute for flank architecture.

original_supplemental_clayalt.observation: Alternate key confirms original shallow radial ribbons, not adequate branching relief.

new_frames.observation: Unlike r006 smooth broad wedge faces, the front-left mid/lower incision has a readable split and join, while the front-right channel shows a narrower subsidiary arm. Broad quiet faces remain between networks. The steep upper cone, broad lower foot and small vent remain legible.

Several large troughs now meet subordinate channels; differently sized divides and terminations interrupt the previous continuous radial panels. Some coarse transverse facets remain but are not continuous material strata or overlapping surfaces.
A central nested incision and subordinate side notches are visible at512px. Broad lower skirt and steep concave summit profile remain; no shield or mesa regression.

Connected recessed trough walls and unequal shoulders replace the old shallow ribbons. Coarse faceted channel walls are consistent with the low-poly scope; no visible detached strips or coplanar flashing.

Several unequal connected incisions and divides are visible in the shaded flank. Quiet apron sectors persist without erasing the branch hierarchy; no requirement for every sector to be deeply dissected.

Distinct wider trunks receive offset narrow branches, especially the lower-center, right and upper-left sectors. Small circular closed vent remains subordinate. Trunk terminations fade into broad skirt instead of all channels running as repeated summit-to-edge spokes.
The same junctions and trough depth survive material override, particularly front-left branch shoulders and front-right main trough. This is actual relief, not palette segmentation.

Primary concave mountain, steep summit and wide skirt persist. Incisions intentionally alter local flank outline and add a right-side notch; silhouette is not claimed identical. Summit and base regression tests support preserved category and scale.

independent_supplemental.observation: Gray top exposes real offset branch junctions and unequal intervening divides.
Gray alternate-key35/38 view preserves the front-left tributary/main trough junction and right main trough with subsidiary arm. No material patch explanation is needed.

scope: Visual verdict concerns the exact static512px evidence; not target GPU/composed scene. Mild faceted steps and quiet panels are not automatically defects under the original brief.
